name: Paraná
summary: A green field crossed by a white diagonal band holding a blue sphere with the Southern Cross, the word 'PARANÁ', and branches of Paraná pine and yerba mate.
origin: First adopted on 9 January 1892, the flag took its present form on 31 March 1947 and was revised in 1990.

symbols.name: Southern Cross
symbols.description: Five stars in a blue sphere.
symbols.meaning: The southern sky, shown as seen from the ground.

symbols.name: Pine and mate
symbols.description: Branches of Paraná pine and yerba mate.

facts: The Tropic of Capricorn crosses northern Paraná.
clues: A white diagonal band on green with a blue sphere and the Southern Cross.
Its band stands for the Tropic of Capricorn.
